# Cypher function conformance

<!-- Generated by `bash scripts/gen-conformance-table.sh`; do not edit by hand. CI fails when it is stale. -->

Every Cypher function the openCypher TCK calls, and every function the engine lists that no TCK scenario calls. Supported is `yes` when every scenario that runs the function passes, `partial` when the engine knows the name but some scenario that runs it fails, and `no` when the engine does not know the name. A scenario that calls several functions counts toward each. The scenarios of `Temporal10.feature` are not counted: they read the clock and pass or fail from run to run, and a table that changed from run to run could not be checked in CI. The page is generated from the same TCK run as [openCypher conformance](conformance.md).
